svg.text: Overall: base 256 x 226 (with skirt), about 245 tall. Pan ±150°, tilt -30° to +60°.
Carrier PCB, Nucleo, Pi 5, Arducam, laser
1. Floor plate -> PCB on standoffs, Pi, rods. 2. Pan motor under the deck, deck on rods.
3. Lazy susan on deck, hub on shaft, U-bracket on hub. 4. Tilt motor on right arm, 608 in left arm, head between.
5. Cover drops over everything onto the floor magnets, hatch on top.
